# OBX Studio — llms.txt

Contemporary digital design and web development studio building custom websites, brand systems, and SEO-driven digital experiences for modern businesses.

OBX Studio creates high-trust, performance-focused websites that combine strategy, design, and development into cohesive digital systems. We work with a limited number of clients to design and build websites that improve credibility, communicate value clearly, and support business growth.

## Core Identity

OBX Studio is a digital design and web development studio specializing in:

- Custom website design and development
- Brand identity systems
- UX and digital strategy
- SEO-optimized website structures
- Performance-focused web experiences

We build complete website systems from concept to launch.

## Services

OBX Studio delivers end-to-end digital systems:

- **Web Design**: User-focused, conversion-driven website design combining layout systems, typography, and visual hierarchy.
- **Web Development**: High-performance, responsive website development focused on speed, scalability, and accessibility.
- **Full Website Builds**: Complete design + development execution from concept to deployment.
- **Brand Identity**: Visual identity systems including logos, typography, and brand guidelines.
- **UX & Strategy**: Information architecture, user flow design, and digital strategy planning.
- **SEO Systems**: Technical SEO, semantic structure, metadata optimization, and content architecture for discoverability.

## Work

Selected projects include:

- **OB Associates** (https://obassociates.netlify.app/) : Corporate website designed to build credibility and support lead generation for professional services.
- **OBX Fash Studio** (https://obxfash.netlify.app/) : Interactive fashion concept combining visual storytelling and modern UI systems.
